recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-47889 unless a future OO decision intentionally rewrites the Device/DeviceMetric boundary text.
issue_request: FHIR-47889 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request from the R6 ballot asking to remove the second occurrence of the sentence "The DeviceMetric models the properties of the Observations generated by the device, such as whether or not the Observation is a setting." from Device Boundaries and Relationships.
initial_application: Commit 75f89720448af324f339037ff4e2bd2fb528c1f7 directly applied FHIR-47889 by deleting the standalone repeated DeviceMetric paragraph from source/device/device-introduction.xml. A later Device text update reintroduced a second copy inside the DeviceMetric bullet, and commit 9da6dbbdac807c987bf499fb59e6d113140c0165 removed it again.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Device as an active resource, so source/device/device-introduction.xml is in current build scope. The current source and combined branch retain one DeviceMetric explanation in the DeviceMetric bullet and omit the duplicate standalone/trailing sentence. OO WGM minutes from 2024-09-24 record the same removal motion with a 7-0-0 vote. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current specification source already reflects the Jira decision and no source edit is needed.
